# Keep public tag event names separate from internal persistent event names

For the nested messages.tags API, the public events onCreated, onUpdated and onDeleted are registered under the messages module and mapped to onTagCreated, onTagUpdated and onTagDeleted. Those persistent handlers subscribe to tag-created, tag-updated and tag-deleted. They wake a suspended listener, unregister the exact callback, and replace the fire object during conversion. Preserve these layer-specific names and callback lifetimes; this is a local API naming and lifecycle pattern, not a universal naming policy. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail / components.
